title: tournefortia incana
intro: Tournefortia incana, commonly known as "Velvet Leaf", is a plant species that belongs to the Bignoniaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat fever, colds, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Tournefortia incana include its use as an expectorant, to relieve coughs and congestion, and as an anti-inflammatory agent, to reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
